findings.description: The implementation reads MAX_BYTES + 1 bytes to detect oversized batches early and uses split('\n') with terminal empty-string removal to preserve intermediate blank lines for rejection by json.loads. Ensure test_ledger_fold.py explicitly tests exact boundary conditions: 131072 bytes accepted, 131073 bytes rejected, 2000 entries accepted, 2001 entries rejected, delta boundaries at +/-10^12, and multiple consecutive newlines.
findings.title: Boundary and Sentinel Coverage in Test Battery

findings.description: The use of object_pairs_hook=unique_object and parse_constant=reject_constant strictly enforces unique keys across nested objects and rejects nonfinite literals (NaN, Infinity), while type(delta) is int excludes booleans and floats. Verify that the test battery includes escaped duplicate keys (e.g., \u0065ntries) and nested duplicate keys.
findings.title: Strict JSON Parsing and Type Invariants

findings.description: README.md specifies interface limits, atomicity, error diagnostics, two reproducible examples, and the exact fixed test runner command (/opt/specorganon/venv/bin/python -I -B /input/delivery/test_ledger_fold.py). The prospective criteria in criteria.md align with contractual expectations and prepare for immutable test battery delivery.
findings.title: Documentation and Criteria Completeness

result.reason: The captured implementation, README, and prospective criteria strictly align with the LedgerFold functional contract. Whole-batch validation enforces byte limits, UTF-8 validity, shape invariants, exact integer deltas without booleans or floats, duplicate key rejection, and lexicographical zero_accounts sorting with complete atomic error handling.
